distance_note: Sited near Agua Vista Park on Terry A. Francois Blvd, within the stretch DataSF's official 'Former San Francisco Redevelopment Agency Project Areas' boundary marks as Mission Bay South, and about 270m from Mission Bay South's own nearest tracked feature -- versus roughly 1,000m from Mission Rock's tracked footprint. No primary source found places this project at "former Pier 64"; that description, from an unsourced summary, is not repeated in this record. Recorded as adjacent to Mission Bay rather than tracked because it is a Port/WETA transit facility, not a Mission Bay OCII development block.
summary: A WETA/Port of San Francisco ferry terminal under construction on Terry A. Francois Blvd near Agua Vista Park, in the Mission Bay/Central Waterfront area. Marine demolition of derelict piles was reported complete in 2025; ferry-landing and upland construction is under way, targeted for completion by the end of 2027.

milestones.text: Phase 2a marine demolition (removal of derelict piles at the site) reported complete.
SFCTA Board approves $4.5M in Prop L sales-tax funds toward the $77.1M Mission Bay Ferry Landing (its share of $9.8M approved for three projects; approved April 14, final approval April 28, 2026).
Completion of the ferry landing is expected by the end of 2027.

open_questions: No primary source found describing this project's site as "former Pier 64"; the Port's own draft Five-Year CIP separately lists a distinct "Pier 64 Sediment Cleanup" line item, suggesting "Pier 64" remains a separate Port designation from this ferry landing.

The project's total budget is reported inconsistently across secondary sources (some cite a much larger total project cost); only the SFCTA-confirmed $4.5M Prop L sales-tax allocation (April 2026) is recorded here as a directly sourced cost figure. SFCTA's April 28, 2026 post gives the total as a $77.1 million ferry landing. Corrected 2026-10-06 (accuracy audit, October 2026): this record earlier gave the allocation as $9.8M, which is the total SFCTA approved for three projects.
Exact construction start and phase-by-phase dates for Phase 2b (ferry landing plus upland improvements) beyond the year-end-2027 completion target are not established here.
